title: RoboCousin: Build Your Own Simulation Playground for Robust Bimanual Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08339v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Bimanual manipulation policies require large and diverse training datasets, yet collecting demonstrations on physical robots is expensive and difficult to scale. Simulation can generate data efficiently, but existing pipelines typically operate within closed asset libraries and predefined scenes: adding a newly observed object or environment still requires substantial effort to reconstruct geometry, specify physical and semantic properties, annotate interactions, and integrate the result into executable tasks. We present RoboCousin, an extensible simulation-based data-generation platform that turns user-provided observations into reusable assets, scenes, and expert trajectories for bimanual manipulation. Built on RoboTwin~2.0, RoboCousin converts object images into simulation-ready assets with visual and collision geometry, semantic and physical metadata, and automatically generated grasp-contact candidates. translated_title: RoboCousin：构建你自己的鲁棒双臂机器人操作仿真游乐场
translated_abstract: 双臂操作策略需要大量且多样化的训练数据集，然而在物理机器人上收集演示数据既昂贵又难以规模化。仿真可以高效地生成数据，但现有流水线通常在封闭的资产库和预定义场景中运行：添加一个新观察到的物体或环境仍然需要大量的工作来重建几何结构、指定物理和语义属性、标注交互，并将结果集成到可执行的任务中。我们提出了RoboCousin，这是一个可扩展的基于仿真的数据生成平台，能够将用户提供的观察结果转化为用于双臂操作的可复用资产、场景和专家轨迹。RoboCousin基于RoboTwin 2.0构建，可将物体图像转换为可用于仿真的资产，包括视觉与碰撞几何、语义与物理元数据，以及自动生成的抓取接触候选点。它进一步构建数字化……
tldr: RoboCousin是一个可扩展的仿真数据生成平台，能将用户提供的物体图像和观察自动转化为仿真资产、场景和专家轨迹，从而高效生成鲁棒双臂机器人操作所需的多样化训练数据。
en_tdlr: RoboCousin is an extensible simulation-based data-generation platform that converts user-provided object images and observations into simulation-ready assets, scenes, and expert trajectories for robust bimanual robotic manipulation.
